old_problem: DeepSeek used undocumented level 5 instead of the source's level 4, while the same code spans three physical variants and the broad run lacked a fixed expected subtest/skip and whole-device health matrix.
disposition_reason: Current NVIDIA DCGM documentation defines suite selectors 1 through 4, with 4 as extended and cumulative; it does not define level 5. The source row/variant and level-4 coverage therefore remain authoritative.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row363 all 18 XLSX columns and history2958.
Verified official DCGM selectors and preserved this physical-row Variant ID independently.
No GPU workload, service or diagnostic was executed.

test_case.test_name: Comprehensive DCGM level-4 software and hardware diagnostic
test_case.purpose: Execute the documented extended suite for this exact same-code physical variant and account for every applicable software and hardware result against synchronized whole-GPU health evidence.
required_package: Pinned DCGM/driver/GPU/firmware compatibility and reviewed diagnostic-test script/hash
Exact level-4 expected test/skip manifest for selected entities
GPU UUID inventory and whole-device health baseline
Thermal/power/error hard stops, OOB and recovery
test_case.test_command: Preserve logs and capture full GPU/memory/PCIe/fabric/thermal/power/service baseline; establish approved DCGM state, run the pinned `dcgmi diag -v -r 4` once for explicit entities, retain complete structured results and telemetry, compare all health deltas, then restore runtime state.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable documented level-4 test for each entity completes PASS, every skip is pre-approved and justified, no unexpected test is absent, and no prohibited memory, PCIe, fabric, thermal, power, XID or service delta occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact variant identity, fixed subtest/skip manifest, complete results and clean health deltas; undocumented level 5, aggregate PASS or another same-code row cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Explicit approval for broad extended diagnostics
Drain all selected workloads and verify cooling/power/OOB capacity
Preserve logs/counters and enforce independent hard stops
Abort on first safety or health anomaly and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Pre/post whole-device health and restored services
test_case.recovery: Abort through supported control, maintain OOB access, restore recorded service/persistence states, isolate any degraded entity, verify enumeration/health and do not rerun automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Official DCGM exposes levels 1-4, so source level 4 is authoritative and DeepSeek's level 5 is rejected.

blocked.reason: The comprehensive scope is defined; exact platform manifest and safety values are runtime gates.
